style: Commit message style: imperative mood summary line, about 50 chars, 72 max, no trailing period. For non trivial changes add a blank line then a body explaining what and why, wrapped at 72. Match the conventions already in the repo log.
deny_ai_trailer: commit style: no AI attribution trailers in commit messages
deny_summary_too_long: commit style: summary line too long, aim for 50 chars, 72 max, put detail in the body
deny_trailing_period: commit style: no trailing period on the summary line
